highlights_headline: The next 4.156 update improves mobile rendering, pixel-copy performance, and native resource reliability.
highlights_body: Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while image-pixel and HarfBuzz feature processing avoid unnecessary allocations.

bullets.detail: Texture rendering on Android now follows the display refresh cadence for smoother front-buffered updates.
Corrects stream retention in front-buffered image handling so native resources are no longer held longer than required.
Reduces overhead when copying image pixels through the managed API.
Avoids allocating native feature strings while preserving the existing feature-decoding behavior.
Includes emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so consumers of the static native library receive the required WebGPU implementation.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the emdawnwebgpu implementation in the static native library
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved the reliability of Blazor CPU sample test timing
